column4: cleat#2880: auditlog's new idempotency regression test for v3's ADD seq/prev_hash/row_hash guard. Dialect-gated whole-test skip (no per-dialect subtest split, same shape as TestV3V4V7MigrationsAreIdempotentOnMySQL above) -- CLEAT_TEST_DB is PostgreSQL only in this job, CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset. Name collides with pagerdutyalert's own TestV3MigrationIsIdempotentOnMySQL below; check-skip-budget.sh's regex is unanchored to package, so one line with count=2 covers both -- see that line's own note.

cleat#2880: jobqueue's (v2: ADD def_name/input/run_id) and kafkaconnect's (v2: ADD event_type) new idempotency regression tests share this exact name across two packages. check-skip-budget.sh's skip-name pool is not package-scoped, so one line with count=2 covers both rather than two lines with the same regex colliding.

cleat#2880: datadogexport's new idempotency regression test for v4's DROP api_key guard.
